$comment: This manifest is the single source of truth for uAgents8's template catalog and the Configure step's env-var form. Keep this file and the platform's catalog in sync by hand - there is no shared-schema generation step yet.
name: CometAPI starter
description: A CometAPI agent (500+ AI models) with a calculator tool and a model call, behind FastAPI.

env_vars.label: CometAPI API key
env_vars.help_text: Your CometAPI key, used as a Bearer token. The template still starts and answers without it. Get one from the CometAPI console.

env_vars.label: Model name
env_vars.help_text: Optional. Any CometAPI model ID, for example gpt-4o-mini (the default), gpt-5-mini, claude-3-5-haiku-latest or deepseek-chat.

env_vars.label: CometAPI base URL
env_vars.help_text: Optional override for the OpenAI-compatible base URL.
